title: Salem City Council Committee on Administration and Finance co-posted COW
text: City of Salem, Massachusetts Office of the City Clerk Maureen Elizabeth Fisher City Clerk October 22, 2026 MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA The City Council Committee on Administration and Finance co-posted with the Committee of the Whole will meet in person on Thursday December 3, 2026, at 6:00 PM for the purpose of discussing Home Rule Petition HRP Short Term Rental (STR) Excise Charge to fund Homelessness Prevention, and Shelter Services. Authorizes the creation a new City Fund for these purposes. This meeting will be held in the City Council Chambers. 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 2nd Floor. Backup Documentation Link: https://cityofsalem1.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/CityCouncil/EtwE4iiBJlNBkKJYYKTtNm4BIj NwQJQlYqYUiuhCByjkPg?e=OxXfSN Please click the link below to join the webinar: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86784688656?pwd=RWXBRTeCYc6B11UNt65SIf52Tqkoio.1 Password: 843222 Or Telephone: 888 475 4499 (Toll Free) 877 853 5257 (Toll Free) Webinar ID: 867 8468 8656 In-Person shall be the primary method of public access to such meetings. A secondary method of public access may be provided, if technologically feasible through Salem Access Television, and or remotely through Zoom. See below for remote access and SATV Information. City of Salem City Council on Administration and Finance co-posted COW Agenda December 3, 2026 Page 2 of 2 “Persons requiring auxiliary aids and services for effective communication such as sign language interpreter, an assistive listening device, or print material in digital format or a reasonable modification in programs, services, policies, or activities, may contact the City of Salem ADA Coordinator at (978-619-5630) as soon as possible and no less than 2 business days before the meeting, program, or event.” AGENDA • # 492 Home Rule Petition HRP Short Term Rental (STR) Excise Charge to fund Homelessness Prevention, and Shelter Services. Authorizes the creation a new City Fund for these purposes. Very truly yours, ATTEST: MAUREEN ELIZABETH FISHER ACTING CITY CLERK “Know Your Rights Under the Open Meeting Law, M.G.L. c. 30A ss. 18-25, and City Ordinance Sections 2-2028 through 2-2033.”
